description: An open-source prototype sandbox for designers and product managers who build. Work with Codex to turn ideas into interactive prototypes using your components, context, and design principles.

interface.shortDescription: Design with intent. Build with an agent.
interface.longDescription:
Design Studio is an open-source prototype sandbox for designers and product managers who build. Codex handles setup and helps you turn ideas into interactive prototypes, connect screens with diagrams and canvases, and capture the thinking behind your work.

Start with included examples, curate a system around your idea, or bring your team’s React components and theme. Give Codex the context, skills, and design principles to build work that feels like yours.

Your code and source files stay in a folder you choose. Customize the studio, share the code with collaborators, and publish interactive prototypes for your team to explore. With ChatGPT Sites available, Codex can publish a viewing link while editing stays local.

Currently in beta.
capabilities: Publish a Studio review link with Sites
defaultPrompt: Help me prototype an idea in Design Studio.
Create my Design Studio locally and publish a public review link with ChatGPT Sites.
